notice: Twenty SP probes of fictional schema shapes are NOT the twenty original AC acceptance cases. Semantic dispositions are review explanations, not executed acceptance checks. No upstream validator or source code was executed; no research question is settled by schema success.

results.title: Positive shape control across the six relevant native record types
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: Shape success is not evidence adjudication.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Not executed. Full validator result is deliberately not claimed.

results.title: Numerator/denominator consistency is not checked by schema
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: Fictional denominator 80 and 51.37 percent cannot arise from an integer harmless count rounded to two decimal places; schema has no count-rounding relation.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection: numeric ranges are checked, but no metric-specific integer numerator/denominator rounding test is implemented (validate_dataset.py:150-214).

results.title: Scheduled question pairs can be mislabeled as completed-answer denominators
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: sample_size is an integer, with no structured sample unit or completion/exclusion accounting.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection: no question/pair/turn/answer population consistency check.

results.title: Publication date substituted for evaluation date remains valid shape
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: A syntactically valid date has no machine-verifiable provenance for its semantic role.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection: full reproducibility only rejects evaluated.kind=unknown; it does not authenticate date-role provenance (215-218).

results.title: Unknown evaluation time plus full reproducibility: schema versus companion check
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: Schema accepts this combination; companion validator has an explicit additional check.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection predicts evaluation_time at lines 215-218; not executed.

results.title: Undocumented judge passes required protocol string shape
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: Neither safety_evaluation nor benchmark_run has a judge-model reference or rubric/run binding.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection: no judge identity, checkpoint, prompt, rating-scale-crosswalk or validation-transfer rule.

results.title: Developer equals evaluator while independence says third_party
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: The same exact actor reference is both developer and evaluator; enum membership does not prove relationship.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection: reference types are checked, but developer/evaluator overlap is not reconciled with independence.

results.title: Adding benchmark independence to safety_evaluation is rejected
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: independence exists only in benchmark_run_data, not safety_evaluation_data.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Schema rejection occurs before companion traversal.

errors.message: Additional properties are not allowed ('independence' was unexpected)

results.title: Changed releases and units coexist without a comparability gate
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: Native envelope can retain both records, but has no typed comparability decision/bridge object. Acceptance of coexistence does not authorize pooling.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection: checks per-record units/ranges, not cross-record benchmark equivalence.

results.title: Eligible with unresolved review/rights is schema-valid but validator-gated
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: Required strings/enums do not implement the publication prerequisite.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection predicts publication_gate at lines 127-129; not executed.

results.title: A legally unsupported rights-inheritance story is an accepted string
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: rights_basis and rights_url cannot verify artifact-specific license applicability. This fixture creates no rights.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection: coarse review/export prerequisites exist; legal scope and veracity are not checked.

results.title: Snapshot shape cannot certify a comparable independent trend
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: A closed hash manifest represents selection at a cutoff, not comparability, truth, independent replication or publishability.
results.companion_validator_static_inspection: Static inspection: closure/hash/cutoff checks exist at lines 306-331; scientific comparability is not checked.

results.title: Empirical decimal JSON number is rejected
results.semantic_disposition_basis: Review-authored explanation; not an executed semantic acceptance test.
results.limitation_demonstrated: Native empirical numeric values must be exact base-10 strings.
